text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden. I have 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, and data analysis, and I’d be glad to help with your data analysis file.

One project I built was a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co., where I created a classifier to route incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues using Python and scikit-learn. It improved macro-F1 to 0.88 from 0.62 with the old keyword rules, and reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes.

I work carefully, follow specs closely, and can keep the output clear and plagiarism-free. Could you share the data file and confirm what kind of analysis or final format you need?
